name: Season 1 LoadingScreen
creator: xllwd1
description:
This loading screen is from Season 1; the "100%" indicator is merely an image and does not reflect actual loading progress. The mod also updates the old spell icons to better match the aesthetic.
The loading backgrounds for all game modes have been changed to black.
The default color is purple when there is no border.
***Note: Hides runes and Summoner icons.***
